product_one_liner.value: Leena AI provides enterprise AI colleagues that automate back-office requests and workflows across IT, HR, finance and procurement.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes per-employee and platform-plus-usage pricing and offers a customized proposal.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in customer case studies describing their use of Leena AI.

hq_location.notes: The October 2026 company announcement identifies New York as headquarters; LinkedIn lists San Francisco.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts cover internal agent benchmarking, authored by VP of Engineering Shubham Agarwal, and the engineering team's PDF-parsing pipeline overhaul.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes AI Colleagues Studio, Workflows Studio and Knowledge Management guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: B Capital's job board advertises Engineering Manager - AL/ML, posted September 3, 2026, with an Apply now option. However, this role is absent from the official Workable index updated November 3, so its availability is less certain.

model_provider.value: Proprietary WorkLM, with model-agnostic support for GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.5, Llama 4 and Grok 4.3.
model_provider.notes: The company describes supported orchestration models, not one exclusive model used in every deployment.

compliance_certs.notes: These four appear explicitly among the company's public compliance claims.

last_funding.notes: IBM Ventures' strategic investment was announced October 20, 2026. The amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: IBM Ventures announced a strategic investment on October 20, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Senior Account Executive - Enterprise posting includes an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Leena Forge launched October 14, 2026, enabling users to build, connect, test and troubleshoot AI colleagues and workflows conversationally.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tarun Bhatti's profile dates his start as Vice President, Product Marketing and Brand Marketing to January 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly requires recording sales activities, leads and opportunities in HubSpot.
